title: Quantify bounded current-row choices in stopped-cover averaging
body:
PR2097 shows that unrestricted current-row-dependent edge choice can destroy the stopped cover's fixed-edge bad fraction despite exact row restoration. This contribution quantifies a bounded replacement: selecting among M fixed one-linear-minor candidates in GL_m(F_q) has sharp maximal bad fraction `(q^(m-2)*(1+M*(q-1))-1)/(q^m-1)` for `1<=M<=q+1`, and one thereafter. A projective pencil attains it for every finite-field order and m>=2.

The proof counts the union of candidate hyperplanes and the equal invertible completions of every nonzero first row. These are standard finite-geometry arguments; novelty is the precise source-contract resource application and its independent evidence, not a new general union theorem. The exact formula is scoped to this linear-minor family, not the selected higher-rank bad varieties.

For general candidate bad sets, the usual M*beta union bound gives a conditional selected allowance: at most seven fixed-width current-field bits retain `10^-16` when every candidate obeys the inherited `beta<=2^19/q`, eligible `q>2^80` premise. All relevant route, guard, coefficient and stopping choices must factor through the declared full transcript. Eight bits merely fail this sufficient worst-q arithmetic; no impossibility or selected failure is claimed. Selector/preparation/routing costs, changed weights, candidate prime eligibility and full recursive admission remain explicit.

Registered CPython 3.12.7 replay passes. A separate Codex agent reviewed the proof/code and independently replayed the optimized primary verifier under CPython 3.12.14 with no blockers. Evidence includes 6,806 complete candidate-subset cases, 23,150 deterministic selector inputs, literal GL2 matrix and first-row frequency counts, independent generic set-union checks, eight semantic/premise controls, and a Git-free optimized replay rejecting live source/snapshot/typed-receipt corruptions. The predecessor's authenticated selected facts and original GL2 witness rerun unchanged; the new counting engines are separate. No selected cold replay, proof-kernel theorem or hosted CI result is claimed.

The source is PR2097 at `1d3ee0926656d5260c6cb1c0b81964ffe9fe1377`, confirmed unchanged. Canonical main remains `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`. Complete 768-PR/1,232-Discussion metadata coverage was supplemented with current source-head checks and the latest 100 updated open PRs; exact dates and limitations are in TASK.json/OVERLAP.json.

No actual adaptive selected compiler, new stock coefficient, supplier, moment root, frontier change or new kappa is supplied. The next step is an emitted full transcript/dependency certificate with a complete selector invoice, or sharper intersections for a concrete actual higher-rank candidate family.

Credit Adam Gall's PR2097 and its retained three-stage-cover, eumemic source527, Rohan Arun PR185/387/1094, Jeremy Kothe PR1087 and PR589 contributor lineage. New work by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human review claimed.

Replay: `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bounded-row-choice`.
